tools.name: find_networks
tools.description: Looks up DePIN networks (and Bittensor subnets) that have live data, by name or ticker, e.g. 'akash', 'helium', 'FIL'. Returns symbol, name, category and the network's public page. Use it to get the symbol that get_network, get_metric_history and verify_value take. Read-only, no key.

tools.name: get_network
tools.description: Returns the latest first-party measurements for one DePIN network (GPU and CPU capacity, storage, node or hotspot counts, on-chain totals), each with value, unit, as_of, freshness and the verify_url on the network's own API that you can open to check it. Market prices are not included. metric_filter

tools.name: get_metric_history
tools.description: Returns the daily series for one network metric (one point per UTC day, with how many observations backed it), e.g. symbol=AKT metric=GPU_ACTIVE. Days with no observation are absent, never zero. The free tier serves the last 7 days and says so in window_notice; an X-API-Key header on the connection

tools.name: verify_value

tools.name: check_balance

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List the current dataset catalog with record counts. Browsing is free; existing query and daily-call limits apply.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Returns the row count of every dataset served here (depin_onchain, market_ticks and the rest), their total, the scope statement and the free-tier limits. No arguments, no key, read-only. For one network's live values use get_network; for freshness and history depth per feed use get_data_dictionary.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, list_products, get_stats, get_data_dictionary · Private data: register_agent, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset · Public sink: register_agent, topup_credits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, list_products, get_stats, get_data_dictionary · Private data: register_agent, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset · Public sink: register_agent, topup_credits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
